query:
SELECT
                instruments.id,
                instruments.name,
                instruments.state as "state: InstrumentState",
                instruments.market_id,
                COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) as "shares!"
            FROM
                instruments
            LEFT JOIN
                positions ON instruments.id = positions.instrument_id
            WHERE
                instruments.market_id = $1
            GROUP BY instruments.id
